title: P7 frozen cached-head sparse-expert control
hypothesis: Freezing and retaining the shared final norm and untied output head at each expert worker can remove duplicated head-gradient uploads and reduce matched warm aggregate tensor traffic while preserving an exact coordinator-owned sparse update.

use_case.claim: Decide whether the P7 sparse topology has enough aggregate warm-transfer value to justify an authenticated T1 process experiment without treating a per-worker saving as a colony-wide result.

baseline.label: Matched frozen-head full sparse control
baseline.description: The full control freezes the same final norm and output head, retains that immutable head after the cold assignment, refreshes all trainable state, and returns only trainable gradients.

primary_metric.label: Warm aggregate round-trip reduction
primary_metric.description: One minus the four-expert warm tensor round trip divided by the matched frozen-head full-control warm tensor round trip.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Two independent one-thread cached-head runs
repeated_validation_suite.description: The primary and repeat records must match in every field except measured step time and combined-process peak RSS.

final_holdout_suite.label: Exact centralized and distributed state comparison
final_holdout_suite.description: Compare trainable raw gradients, clipped gradients, AdamW state, complete model state, loss, routing, and the frozen-head identity.

guardrails.label: Exact canonical update
guardrails.description: Centralized and distributed raw gradients, clipped gradients, AdamW state, model state, and loss must match exactly.

guardrails.label: Frozen head remains closed
guardrails.description: The final norm and output head must retain their initial digest and acquire neither gradients nor optimizer state.

guardrails.label: Matched cache accounting
guardrails.description: Cold comparisons include the head for both paths; warm comparisons exclude the same retained immutable head from both paths and refresh all trainable state.

guardrails.label: Deterministic repeat
guardrails.description: Both evidence runs must match in all routing, state, loss, hash, parameter, and byte fields.

independent_variables.label: Shared head contract
independent_variables.description: The earlier P7 tracer trained and duplicated head gradients; this control freezes the same head and retains its bytes as an immutable per-worker cache.

controlled_variables.label: T0 model, fixture, and routing
controlled_variables.description: The T0 architecture, initialization seed, synthetic batch, four experts, top-1 capacity 128 routing, and auxiliary routing weight remain fixed.

controlled_variables.label: Canonical reduction and optimizer
controlled_variables.description: Token-loss scaling, input-adjoint scattering, fixed expert order, one global clip, and coordinator-owned AdamW remain fixed.
